name: Infoblox — DHCP Address Offered to Randomized (Locally Administered) MAC
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DHCP"
| alter mac = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "([0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})"), 0)),
        ip  = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "(?:DHCPACK|DHCPOFFER) on (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        hostname = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "\((\S+?)\) via"), 0),
        relay = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, " via (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
| filter mac != null and ip != null
| filter mac ~= "^.[26ae]:"
| comp count_distinct(mac) as random_macs, values(ip) as ip_list, values(relay) as relays,
       min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by relay
| fields relay, random_macs, ip_list, first_seen, last_seen
description: DHCP offered or leased an address to a locally-administered (randomized) MAC. Managed hosts use burned-in MACs; random ones come from unmanaged devices, MAC-spoofing or DHCP-starvation tools (many per relay).
alert_name: Infoblox — DHCP Address Offered to Randomized (Locally Administered) MAC
alert_description:
What fired: DHCP offered or leased an address to a locally-administered (randomized) MAC. Managed hosts use burned-in MACs; random ones come from unmanaged devices, MAC-spoofing or DHCP-starvation tools (many per relay).

Why it matters: an unmanaged, spoofed or rogue device may be on the network. Assessed severity: Medium.

Investigate:
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity ($relay) to related activity in the same window.
  - Check the asset inventory / owner for the device or user involved.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized before escalating.
